title: Docs and spec still say ban-user / unban-user need the admin plugin (true before #33227): actions.mdx worked example and AuthFamiliesSchema.admin describe
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmT2NE3iyG1o6TDg3sf

Filing gate: ③ a nit-graded finding (N3) of the contract record 6897296837 on PR #33989 (#33759), class b (published prose teaches a behaviour the tree no longer has).
Reader: none named — the two sites sit in `domain:spec` (`packages/spec/src/api/discovery.zod.ts`) and the docs surface (`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`); triage routes.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open ban-user admin plugin docs`, `AuthFamiliesSchema admin describe` — no open card.

## 维护者速读

#33227 之后，停用 / 恢复用户（ban-user / unban-user）不再需要 admin 插件；#33759 已让界面按钮去掉这个限制。但两处对外文字还写着「需要 admin 插件」：协议文档的动作示例，以及 spec 里 `AuthFamiliesSchema.admin` 的说明（说 admin 关闭时这些路由返回 404）。AI 和开发者读到会写错。

## Facts (read on the PR #33989 head `8631da39`, per the record)

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` uses `ban_user` with `requiresFeature: admin` as its worked example of a feature-gated action.
- `AuthFamiliesSchema.admin` in `packages/spec/src/api/discovery.zod.ts` lists `ban-user` among the routes that answer 404 when the flag is false. Since #33227 (`cbb876c1`) the ban / unban doors are mounted unconditionally (`admin-ban-endpoints.ts`).
- The Docs Drift Check did not flag either.

## Ask

Correct both texts to the current behaviour (pick a still-gated action such as `impersonate_user` for the docs example; drop `ban-user` / `unban-user` from the 404 list), with the spec describe change carrying its own changeset. Re-check after #33989 lands.

Blocked-by: #33759
